company.name: Inkitt
company.shortDescription: Inkitt is building the operating system for storytellers. We’re an AI-powered 1-stop shop helping creators make bestselling franchises.
company.description: Inkitt is building the operating system for storytellers, an AI-powered one stop shop for creators to make bestselling books, audiobooks, and movies. Over the past decade, we’ve built a proprietary AI pipeline that analyzes over 1,200 behavioral signals across 400,000+ manuscripts that discovers potential bestsellers on Inkitt.com, AB tests them into hits on Galatea, and scales them into movies on CandyJar, generating a new $1M bestselling novel every 7 days at a 40x better hit rate than traditional publishing. That prediction engine also powers Ironblood, the first 100% AI-generated streaming platform, where AI greenlights and generates content with no actors or cameras. Inkitt’s validated IP reaches over 1 million paid subscribers across Galatea and CandyJar. Inkitt is now opening that same engine to every storyteller: creators can now use Inkitt’s MCP server,  AI audiobook tools, AI movie generation agent and AI influencer harness.
